The behavioral A/B was right (21.7% divergence = real intervention) but the divergent picks were net-WORSE. gygax's expert 'lowest-risk' pick was the most harmful in isolation -> the poisoned-well critique VINDICATED: even expert priors are anti-correlated here. 0-for-4 on beating v4. Calibration holds: p=0.40 -> Brier 0.16.

Vindicates DECK-as-lever WHEN the deck is bot-friendly (31E/8P/21T) AND v4 already matches its experts — not the general "deck is the lever" (falsified for weak pilots).

forecast.ground_truth: public ladder (pokemon-tcg-ai-battle): gumi's v8 threat-aware pilot on our Dwebble/Crustle deck (sub 53930398) = 808.9 vs the registered v4-Dwebble baseline ~787 = HELD, +21.9 (≈0.531 implied H2H → margin ~0.031, a SMALL positive). v8 also beats the CURRENT v4-Dwebble snapshot (sub 53868523, now 754.9) by +54. The pilot is a SMALL-but-real LADDER lever — and the N=40 seeded coliseum read v8 vs v4 as WITHIN-NOISE (Wilson CI straddles 0.50): the §5b band-pass in action — near-peer PILOT effects are ladder-only-resolvable, the coliseum cannot settle them. Confirms deck = big lever, pilot = small lever. NOTE: our OWN v7 pilot (heuristic_v7) is within-noise of this farmed v8 in the coliseum → v7 is the candidate to reproduce this small edge with our own code on the next slot.

forecast.ground_truth: public ladder: crustle+Switch+Lumiose Galette (status-clear, sub 53955582) = 986.1 vs the contemporaneous v4-Dwebble base ~754.9 = HELD, +231.2 (implied ~0.79, a LARGE effect) — a new PB by +177 over the prior best (v8-Dwebble 808.9). The DIAGNOSTIC SWEEP localized the eroding counter as STATUS (poison/burn — the ex-wall is null to between-turns damage). Calibration: predicted p=0.38 (gygax's WEAKEST read) → HELD = UNDER-confident on the winner again (Brier 0.3844), the Dwebble pattern repeating: the poisoned well runs the wrong way even for the expert — his TOP read (cage, p=0.45) was FALSIFIED while this, his bottom read, won biggest. The sweep (orchestrated diversity) + the ladder (ground truth) found the answer expertise alone could not.
forecast.label: crustle+Switch+Lumiose Galette — clear special conditions (status counter)
forecast.local_evidence: Switch [1123] (retreat clears conditions) + Lumiose Galette [1153] (heal 20 + remove a Special Condition) answer the one damage type the ex-wall can't stop (status, placed between turns). Paid from over-floored Basic {G} (the do-no-harm fix of the regressed pivotcleanse). Pre-screen N=30 v7: within-noise of the v4-PB. DOUBT: gygax's weakest read; the heal is only 20 (value is the status-clear); flat if no status in the meta.
forecast.proposition: crustle+Switch+Lumiose Galette (v4 pilot) beats the contemporaneous v4-Dwebble base (~754.9) on the ladder by a margin the games can resolve

forecast.ground_truth: public ladder: crustle+Battle Cage (bench-spread protection, sub 53955580) = 600.0 vs contemporaneous v4-Dwebble base ~754.9 = FALSIFIED, -154.9 (LARGE adverse). gygax's HIGHEST-confidence read (named-Alakazam bench-spread) was the WORST outcome — Battle Cage stadium diluted the deck and the eroding counter was NOT bench-spread (it was status, per cleanse 986.1).
